events.description:
Called with a series' key when its entry is pressed; each entry is then a toggle button (`aria-pressed` while
the series is shown). Every chart passes it, so a reader can hide and show series.
events.name: onToggle

props.description: The series named, in order; each takes its colour as the chart does.
props.name: series

props.description: The palette the chart's series take by position; `accent` by default.
props.name: palette

props.description: The keys of the series hidden from the plot: their swatch is hollow and their label struck through.
props.name: hiddenKeys

props.description: Adds a dashed "Previous period" entry, for a chart drawing its comparison.
props.name: showComparison

props.description: Extra classes for the legend container.
props.name: className
